messages.content: "Can you help me plan my day? I want to start from my home in New York and go to a chess club named 'Knight Gambit' located in Boston. I want to take the fastest route. After that, I want to go to another chess club named 'Rook Corner' in Philadelphia, again taking the fastest route. Finally, I want to return home, but this time I want to take the shortest route. Can you also provide me with the details of the events hosted by both chess clubs?"

We have to produce a response that includes the route calculations and event details. The user wants to start from home in New York, go to Knight Gambit in Boston, then to Rook Corner in Philadelphia, then back home via shortest route. They want event details for both clubs.

We should call chess_club_details_find twice: once for Knight Gambit in Boston, once for Rook Corner in Philadelphia. Then call route_planner_calculate_route three times: NY->Boston fastest, Boston->Philadelphia fastest, Philadelphia->NY shortest.
